title: U Mass - Acute Lipid Infusion
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xm5fk86

steps.title: Perform Survival Surgery
steps.instruction: Establish a chronic indwelling catheter for intravenous infusion 5-6 days prior to the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Refer to M1023: Surgery-jugular vein cannulation

steps.title: Fast Mice
steps.instruction: Fast the mice either overnight (~15 hours) or for 5 hours before starting the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Infusion
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse in a rat-size restrainer and tether the tail with tape at one end.

steps.title: Prepare Catheter and Pump
steps.instruction: Expose and flush the intravenous catheter with saline solution, then connect it to the CMA Microdialysis infusion pump.

steps.title: Collect Basal Plasma Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a 10 µl plasma sample (basal-0 min) before starting the infusion to measure basal fatty acid levels.

steps.title: Initiate Intravenous Infusion
steps.instruction: Turn on the pump to begin infusion in awake mice using one of the following groups:

substeps.instruction: Experimental group: Infuse 20% Intralipid (triglyceride emulsion) at 2.5 ml/kg/hr and heparin at 6 U/hr.
Control group: Infuse 20% glycerol at 2.5 ml/kg/hr.

steps.title: Collect Periodic Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 10 µl plasma samples at 120, 240, and 300 min to measure serum FFA levels.

steps.title: Collect Tissues
steps.instruction: Collect tissues at the end of the experiment for biochemical and molecular analyses.

steps.title: Optional: Perform Hyperinsulinemic-Euglycemic Clamp
steps.instruction: Following the 5-hr acute lipid infusion, a 2-hr hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp may be performed to measure the effects of elevated fatty acids on insulin sensitivity.
